title: Bottomless Glass of Puker Juice
description: Bottomless Glass of Puker Juice — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 15 Glasses of Puker Juice

Quest Reward: 1250 Gold + 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 15 Glasses of Puker Juice from the Fire Mutant Pukers in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

If you are up to it I need you to gather some more Puker Juice for me. These experiments consume a lot of this resource and frankly all that work makes me parched, so a good amount goes towards quenching my thirst. Did you know Puker Juice is fortified with electrolytes and some other stuff that I can't identify? Well, it is, take my word for it, it's extreme!

Go out and squeeze some more Puker Juice from the Fire Mutant Pukers in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome. When you have enough return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Wonderful! Let me know when you are resupplied and ready to help me out.

Objectives:

  • Glass of Puker Juice ×15

Level range: 10–25
